dialogues.speaker: Rhythmos
dialogues.text: Hmm, the sound of the ball hitting the target is nice and crisp. If we can work it into a steady rhythm, it'd make the perfect accompanying beat!

choices.text: I'd like to play a round of Rhythm Ball!

response.speaker: Rhythmos
response.text: Alright, I'm looking forward to your performance. Get out there and give 'em a show!

response.speaker: Rhythmos
response.text: Hey there, and welcome to our game!

response.speaker: Rhythmos
response.text: I'm a musician hired by Master Xilonen to run this Dance-Off Stage.

response.speaker: Rhythmos
response.text: Yeah! Whether it's the technology that goes into designing, building, and maintaining our equipment, or the ability to DJ, Xilonen's the master that all us musicians aspire to be!

response.speaker: Rhythmos
response.text: When she's DJ-ing, she flows freely between dozens of styles and techniques. Simply put, she can handle any style, with style!

response.speaker: Rhythmos
response.text: And her sense of hearing is, like, razor-sharp!

response.speaker: Rhythmos
response.text: Whenever part of a song's too dry, whenever there's a pitch deviation of more than half a semitone, or whenever the sound effects have been pushed just a bit too far — Master Xilonen can tell, even with her ears stuffed full of Quenepa Berries!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why would she stuff her ears with...

response.speaker: Rhythmos
response.text: Quenepa Berries? Because they're full of juice, and listening through them's like being stuck underwater. It's the toughest of trials for any musician around!

response.speaker: Rhythmos
response.text: Although Master Xilonen didn't mention it, I feel like sharp hearing's also helpful for warriors and adventurers.

response.speaker: Rhythmos
response.text: If you wanna sharpen your ears, pay Master Xilonen a visit!

response.speaker: Rhythmos
response.text: Any time's a good time! Don't be shy about saying hi if you see any of our DJs putting on a show!
